name: CaseBoxShadowOkStack
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "box-shadow-ok-stack" (effects). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TWO-layer elevation whose every layer colour is an OKLab spelling — the drop half of astryx's `shadow-med` (examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json)
